english.title: Being equipped to lock on
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), had an object with you, namely **(..SPECIFY OBJECT..), in a place other than a dwelling, namely **(..SPECIFY PLACE..), with the intention that it may be used in the course of or in connection with the commission by yourself or another person of an offence of locking on under section 1(1) of the Public Order Act 2023
english.legislation: Contrary to section 2(1) and (2) of the Public Order Act 2023.

english.notes:
(i) See section 34 for the meaning of 'serious disruption'.
(ii) For the purpose of the offence, a dwelling is a building or structure which is used as a dwelling or, a part of a building or structure, if the part is used as a dwelling including any yard, garden, grounds, garage or outhouse belonging to and used with a dwelling.
